description: Every span endpoint must snap to a network node within 0.1 meters.
query:
WITH endpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS span_id,
        name,
        ST_StartPoint(geom) AS start_pt,
        ST_EndPoint(geom) AS end_pt
    FROM spans
)
SELECT 
    e.span_id,
    e.name,
    'Start or end point not connected to any node' AS failure_reason
FROM endpoints e
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM nodes n 
    WHERE ST_DWithin(e.start_pt::geography, n.geom::geography, 0.1)
)
OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM nodes n 
    WHERE ST_DWithin(e.end_pt::geography, n.geom::geography, 0.1)
);

description: Feeder cables cannot terminate directly at a premise location.
query:
WITH feeder_endpoints AS (
    SELECT 
        id AS cable_id,
        ST_EndPoint(geom) AS end_pt
    FROM cables
    WHERE type = 'FEEDER'
)
SELECT 
    f.cable_id,
    'Feeder cable illegally terminated at premise ' || p.id AS failure_reason
FROM feeder_endpoints f
JOIN premises p 
  ON ST_DWithin(f.end_pt::geography, p.geom::geography, 0.1);

description: Splitters cannot have more connected drops than max_ports.
query:
WITH connections AS (
    SELECT 
        e.id AS equip_id,
        e.max_ports,
        COUNT(c.id) AS connected_drops
    FROM equipment e
    JOIN cables c 
      ON ST_DWithin(e.geom::geography, ST_StartPoint(c.geom)::geography, 0.1)
      OR ST_DWithin(e.geom::geography, ST_EndPoint(c.geom)::geography, 0.1)
    WHERE c.type = 'DROP'
    GROUP BY e.id, e.max_ports
)
SELECT 
    equip_id,
    'Capacity exceeded: ' || connected_drops || ' drops on a ' || max_ports || ' port splitter' AS failure_reason
FROM connections
WHERE connected_drops > max_ports;

description: All equipment must have a valid max_ports assignment greater than 0.
query: SELECT id AS equip_id, type, 'Equipment has invalid max_ports' AS failure_reason FROM equipment WHERE max_ports <= 0 OR max_ports IS NULL;
